display.label: Azure Firewall
display.description: Cloud-native intelligent network firewall security service providing threat protection for Azure workloads

resource.key_description: The unique name for the Azure Firewall. Serves as the map key.

sections.label: Basic Configuration
sections.description: Core Azure Firewall identification and SKU settings.

fields.label: Firewall Name
fields.description: Specifies the name of the Azure Firewall. Must be 1-80 characters using alphanumerics, hyphens, periods, or underscores.

validation.pattern_error: Firewall name must be 1-80 characters, begin with an alphanumeric character, end with an alphanumeric character or underscore, and contain only alphanumerics, hyphens, periods, or underscores.

fields.label: Resource Group Name
fields.description: The name of the Resource Group in which the Azure Firewall should exist.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: The Azure Region where the Firewall should be created.

fields.label: SKU Name
fields.description: SKU name of the Firewall. AZFW_VNet for Virtual Networks, AZFW_Hub for Secured Virtual Hubs.

fields.label: SKU Tier
fields.description: SKU tier of the Firewall (Basic, Standard, or Premium).

sections.label: VNet IP Configuration
sections.description: IP configuration for Virtual Network-based firewalls (AZFW_VNet).

fields.label: IP Configurations
fields.description: List of IP configuration blocks. The primary configuration must reference AzureFirewallSubnet.

fields.label: Configuration Name
fields.description: The name of the IP configuration.

fields.label: Subnet ID
fields.description: The resource ID of AzureFirewallSubnet. Required for the primary IP configuration.

fields.label: Public IP Address ID
fields.description: The resource ID of the associated Public IP address (Standard SKU).

fields.label: Management IP Configuration
fields.description: Management IP configuration required for Basic SKU or forced tunneling.

fields.label: Management Config Name
fields.description: The name of the management IP configuration.

fields.label: Management Subnet ID
fields.description: The resource ID of AzureFirewallManagementSubnet.

fields.label: Management Public IP ID
fields.description: The resource ID of the management Public IP address.

sections.label: Virtual WAN Hub Configuration
sections.description: Virtual Hub configuration used when SKU Name is AZFW_Hub.

fields.label: Virtual Hub Settings
fields.description: Deploy inside an Azure Virtual WAN Virtual Hub.

fields.label: Virtual Hub ID
fields.description: The resource ID of the Virtual Hub.

fields.label: Public IP Count
fields.description: The number of public IPs assigned to the firewall in the hub.

sections.label: Policy & Security Settings
sections.description: Firewall policy, threat intelligence, availability zones, and SNAT settings.

fields.label: Firewall Policy ID
fields.description: The resource ID of the Azure Firewall Policy to associate.

fields.label: Threat Intelligence Mode
fields.description: Operation mode for threat intelligence filtering.

fields.label: Availability Zones
fields.description: List of Availability Zones in which this Firewall should be deployed (e.g. ['1', '2', '3']).

fields.label: Private IP Ranges (SNAT)
fields.description: List of SNAT private CIDR IP ranges or ['IANAPrivateRanges'].

sections.label: DNS Settings
sections.description: DNS resolution and DNS proxy settings.

fields.label: Custom DNS Servers
fields.description: List of DNS server IP addresses used by the Azure Firewall.

fields.label: Enable DNS Proxy
fields.description: Whether DNS proxy is enabled on the Azure Firewall.

sections.label: Tags
sections.description: Key-value pairs to categorize and organize Azure Firewall resources.

fields.label: Resource Tags
fields.description: A mapping of tags to assign to the Azure Firewall.
